label: The AWS partnership
text: I handle the technical side of TrendAI's AWS relationship. That means making sure what we say about Vision One holds up when an engineer digs into it, working with AWS teams on where our products fit together, and putting together briefings for leadership on both sides.

label: Co-Sell IQ
text: I built TrendAI Co-Sell IQ on the new AWS Partner Central Agent. It takes the repetitive front end of co-sell off our sellers, and it was highlighted in the keynote at the AWS Marketplace Sellers Conference.

label: Programs that scale
text: At every company I've worked for, I've ended up building something that lets the work keep going without me: a year-long certification program at Fast Enterprises, Express Onboarding at Black Duck (which I helped build), and an AI Security workshop at TrendAI.

label: Leading teams
text: At Fast Enterprises I managed 14 developers and 3 subject matter experts while still writing code myself, and handled hiring from campus recruiting through final-round interviews. At Black Duck I helped hire and onboard new team members and became the go-to person for Polaris questions.
